module_docstring:
PostToolUse hook: run harness audit when a harness file is edited. Stdlib only.

Wire in .claude/settings.json:
  "PostToolUse": [{"matcher": "Edit|Write",
    "hooks": [{"type": "command",
               "command": "uv run python3 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/hooks/harness_audit/audit_hook.py""}]}]
Exit 2 feeds violations back to the editing agent (works for agents without Bash).

Index regeneration (agent_docs/harness-index.md) is a separate concern, its
own hook: sync_hook.py.

functions.docstring:
True if rel is under either CLI's harness tree, under agent_docs/ (deep-dive
docs harness-expert owns), is an AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md anywhere, or is any other
markdown file in the repo.
Any other .md file gets audit.py's "other_md" kind - md-format's one-sentence-
per-line and dead-reference checks, no token budget.
Dual-harness aware - this repo tracks .claude/, .agents/, and .codex/ equally.
Expects a posix-style rel path (main() normalizes) - audit.py's violation
lines use the same form, so relevant_violations() can prefix-match them.
